ICCV 2025·HccePose(BF)↗

HCCEPose

从一张 RGB 图像
估计已知物体的 6D 位姿6D pose estimation
from a single RGB image

HccePose(BF) 同时预测物体前、后表面的坐标，再通过 2D–3D 对应求出物体相对于相机的旋转和平移。HccePose(BF) predicts coordinates on the front and back surfaces of a known object. These 2D–3D correspondences give the rotation and translation of the object relative to the camera.

RGB图像输入Image input

BF前后表面联合预测Front and back surfaces

2D ↔ 3D超密集对应Ultra-dense correspondences

6D旋转与平移Rotation & translation

01方法METHOD

一个像素，
两个表面点One pixel,
two surface points

C₁ → C₈

同一条相机射线
与物体前、后表面相交。Where a camera ray meets
the object surface

沿这条射线，最近的表面交点对应前表面，最远的交点对应后表面。网络分别预测两个交点的层次化连续坐标编码。解码后，同一个图像像素就能对应物体坐标系中的两个三维点。The nearest intersection lies on the front surface and the farthest on the back surface. The network predicts a hierarchical continuous coordinate code for each. Decoding both gives two 3D points in the object coordinate frame for the same pixel.

查看方法详解↗Read about the method↗
  1. 01

    检测与表面预测Detect & predict surfaces

    YOLO 检出物体后，HccePose 在裁剪区域内预测掩码和前、后表面的坐标编码。YOLO detects the object. HccePose predicts a mask and coordinate codes for both surfaces in the cropped image.

  2. 02

    构建 2D–3D 对应Match pixels to 3D points

    解码前、后表面坐标，将掩码内的像素与对应的三维点配对。Decode the surface coordinates and pair each pixel inside the mask with its 3D points.

  3. 03

    求解 6D 位姿Estimate the 6D pose

    结合相机内参，用 PnP 求解物体到相机的旋转和平移。Solve PnP with the camera intrinsics to recover object-to-camera rotation and translation.

检测器可以识别多个类别，位姿权重按物体加载。准备匹配的模型与相机内参，即可接入自己的图像。The detector can identify multiple categories; pose weights are loaded per object. Supply matching models and camera intrinsics to work with your images.
